evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Positional authority sets a recurring mandate, then pressures compliance by framing unrehearsed rollbacks as effectively nonexistent.
Restates the mandated cadence as established fact, reinforcing positional authority's standing requirement.
The named authority figure whose position underwrites the directive; identification of the mandate's source.

mints.name: MandateByExistentialFraming
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is compliance being pressured by framing the unperformed action as tantamount to not possessing the capability at all?
